@Gideon Sato, the channel shows you first reported the kiosks offline on 3 Aug at **10:42 AM**. Your message said both inbound lanes were showing a white screen after badge scan, and that the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard.

The channel has no other guard updates. The only later guard detail is from Mateo at 11:03 AM, when kiosk 1 came back and "guard checked in trailer 8836; dispatch sees it." So for the postmortem, the guard was logging trailers on paper from at least 10:42, and the record doesn't show what the guard did between then and kiosk 1's return.
